name: simple DAG — linear chain
code:
graph = {0: [1], 1: [2], 2: [3], 3: []}
result = topological_sort(graph)
assert result is not None
assert len(result) == 4
assert result.index(0) < result.index(1) < result.index(2) < result.index(3)

name: DAG with branching
code:
graph = {0: [1, 2], 1: [3], 2: [3], 3: []}
result = topological_sort(graph)
assert result is not None
assert len(result) == 4
assert result.index(0) < result.index(1)
assert result.index(0) < result.index(2)
assert result.index(1) < result.index(3)
assert result.index(2) < result.index(3)

name: graph with isolated node
single node no edges
code:
graph = {0: []}
result = topological_sort(graph)
assert result is not None
assert result == [0]
